Quad - [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px]]190 (Hard) |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Below Average (2.75) |cash = {{Money|150}} on death |spawned_by = [[Grandmother Ducky]] |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = {{Attr|Health Regen}} |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Obese Conscription}}''' - Upon its destruction, the '''Aged Eggroll 1''' spawns one [[Nimble]] [[Fat Ducky (Ducky Revenge)|Fat Ducky]]. }} ==Description== The '''Aged Eggroll 1''', which uses the display name of '''Aged Eggroll''', was a small enemy that appeared in [[Bathroom Approach]] as part of the [[Ducky Revenge Event]] and its rerun in the [[Spring Frenzy Battle Pass]]. It has average health, below average speed and [[Health Regen]]. It can appear naturally and is also spawned by the [[Grandmother Ducky]] upon its death. Upon its destruction, it spawns a [[Nimble]] [[Fat Ducky (Ducky Revenge)|Fat Ducky]]. ==Appearance== The '''Aged Eggroll 1''' is a blue egg with cyan stripes that rolls the surface on the path. It has the head of a duckling sticking out of a crack in the egg. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Bathroom Approach]] is listed instead. *The '''Aged Eggroll 1''' always spawns alongside other eggrolls and summons an enemy on death. **Area of effect towers, like the [[Mortar]], [[Pyromancer]] or [[Rocketeer]] can be useful here because of this, as they can damage all the eggrolls at once. **Single target towers like the [[Crook Boss]], [[Pursuit]], [[Turret]] or [[Minigunner]] can also be helpful. *The [[Hacker]] can be used to prevent the '''Aged Eggroll 1''' from summoning anything on death. **Due to it having [[Health Regen]] by default, it will actually keep regenerating health even when converted, making it especially useful to convert. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1Aged1.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseAged1.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (16 April 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Ducky Revenge Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Aged Eggroll 1''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} AgedEggroll1IconIG.png|'''Aged Eggroll 1''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Aged Eggroll 1''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''16 April 2025''' -
